item.title: Two more tankers hit naval mines in Strait of Hormuz, says IRGC Navy
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy has reported a massive explosion and intense fire involving two more oil tankers after they hit naval mines, while attempting to transit via prohibited and unsafe routes in the Strait of Hormuz.
